scope: forensic mathematical, semantic, privacy, rendering, stress, regression, live-API, browser, packaging and local-model validation
confirmed_findings_fixed: undersized experience cohorts were not consistently suppressed
numeric identifier-like fields could enter experience association analysis
aggregate analysis exposed employee-level low-score/risk records
manager-level experience ranking remained available at the engine boundary
diagnostic-style score labels implied unsupported engagement diagnosis
lifecycle outputs exposed undersized measured cohorts
integer-style score bands left gaps for decimal composite values
case-insensitive duplicate signal columns produced order-dependent semantics
small overall low-score cells were disclosive
small score-band cells lacked primary suppression
single suppressed score bands could be reconstructed without complementary suppression
small lifecycle low-score cells were disclosive
suppressed aggregate values could be coerced to fabricated zero at the API summary boundary
frontend numeric formatting crashed on correctly suppressed null values
frontend lower-band summaries could imply precision when component cells were suppressed
legacy regression contracts required individual ranking, manager ranking, diagnostic labels or disclosive small cells

browser_acceptance.note: first attempt had a known transient desktop upload wait; unchanged rerun passed

privacy_and_semantic_guarantees: experience outputs are aggregate-first and individual experience-risk lists are not exposed
identifier-like columns are excluded from experience association analysis
score bands use continuous non-overlapping intervals and neutral descriptive labels
undersized measured cohorts and low-score cells fail closed
complementary suppression prevents reconstructing a single hidden score-band cell from totals
suppressed values remain null/explicitly suppressed through engine, schema, API and frontend and are never fabricated as zero
experience associations are labelled observational rather than causal
missing or invalid survey responses are excluded rather than replaced with HRIS proxy sentiment
merge_rule: This evidence record is documentation-only. Merge only after the evidence-only PR head reproduces the required workflow gates successfully.
